AG_L3.proof_route_1: J=M-r and r is integral, so floor((1+alpha)r+1/3)-r=floor(alpha*r+1/3).
AG_L3.proof_route_2_induction: with j=J(r-1), the exact event criterion is equivalent to 3j+2<=3alpha*r; because 0<alpha<1 this is exactly the condition that floor(alpha*r+1/3) increments from j to j+1.

compatibility_notation: alpha=-1+2/sqrt(3) may be displayed only after the polynomial derivation; it is not the runtime definition.

root_typing.irrationality: discriminant 48 is not a rational square; hence alpha is irrational
